system.longDesc: If you can see it, you can hit it. Hard.

degree0.desc: You strike where it hurts the most. Once per round, you can add 1d6 to the damage of a successful attack if your Dexterity is greater than your target’s.

degree1.desc: Your instinct is as sharp as your eyes. When you take the Aim action, the attack bonus you gain is +2 instead of +1.

degree2.desc: SP. You can also use it with any weapon, not just guns.
